values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/beaufortlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat ramp to Beaufort Lake on the west side of the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/beaufortlake ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'There is ramp access to Beaufort Lake located on the west side of the campground'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/beaufortlake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Seven sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/beaufortlake ('There are seven sites for tent and small trailer use', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (7 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on 462-acre Beaufort Lake (connected to George and Ruth lakes by streams, good paddling), 1.5 miles southeast of Three Lakes via US-41 and Beaufort Road, Baraga County. Sites on an open lakeshore lawn. Dark night skies. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 7 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport (fees.note), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat ramp (facilities.note), first-come only, 15-day max (now on the entry); season Nov 1 - May 1 closure already manual; phone 906-339-4461 (Van Riper SP) matches.
